GATE RUSH 1.4.0 — TYPES CORE (P1T) — draft for docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/GDD.md (P10 folds it in)
==================================================================================================

1. TYPE MODEL (js/data.js, region "LEVEL_TYPES + LEVEL_ROTATION + helpers")
- LEVEL_TYPES[key] for the 8 type keys standard, horde, night, chase, escort, nightHorde, nightChase, nightEscort:
  { base, night, debut, color, badge, bonusMult, enabled, assist[, starThree, runShare] }, plus combos (false), meetAfter (5)
  and retypeRewardSkip ([]).
  - base picks the generator (levelgen) and the ModeSystem (level.js MODE_OF: horde -> ctx.hold). night is runtime only.
  - debut: horde 4, night 7, chase 12, escort 18, nightHorde 47, nightChase 53, nightEscort 58 (first level of the key on the
    full 1.5.0 map). Debut softeners and the first meeting key on it, never on a level number.
  - bonusMult: standard 1.0, night 1.10, horde 1.25, chase / escort 1.15, combos base + 0.05.
  - assist: 'soldiers' (standard, night, chase), 'kits' (horde, nightHorde), 'plates' (escort; not built).
  - starThree: horde 0.9 (D16); others use data.starThree(L). runShare: horde 0.4 (game-over fraction).
  - enabled: standard true; everything else false in this build. P8 turns horde and night on (stage 1.4.0).
- LEVEL_ROTATION: cycle1 / cycle2 code tables (S, H, N, C, E, NH, NC, NE per district slot), nightSlot 3, nightFinales [3, 6],
  codes. Cycle k >= 3: district d takes slots 2-4 of cycle 2's district ((d - 1 + k - 2) mod 6) + 1, the night modifier on
  slot 3 when that pattern has none, finale N in districts 3 and 6, S elsewhere.
- Staged fallback: a disabled base plays standard keeping its night; a night combo plays its base by day unless combos is on
  and the combo key is enabled; a combo whose base is off plays 'night'.
- Helpers:
  - levelTypeOf(L, override, on) -> frozen { key, base, night, slot (1-5), cycle, finale (slot 5), code }; memoized per level
    when neither override nor on is given. override = a key played instead (level.js passes ?type= only with ?debug=1);
    on = tools only, { key: bool, combos } replacing the stage flags.
  - eTargetOf(L, override, on): eBossOf(L), or round5(HORDE_GEN.eHoldShare * eBossOf(L)) on a Horde base.
  - starThreeOf(L, key): the key's starThree, else starThree(L).
  - nextLevelOfType(key, fromL, on): first level >= fromL of that key within 60 levels, 0 when none (the Field Guide's
    'MEET IT ON LEVEL n': 43 for horde and 45 for night from the owner's frontier once enabled).
- The 1.4.0 map (stage horde + night): L1-60 S 40, H 12 (4 9 13 19 23 29 32 39 43 47 52 59), N 8 (7 14 17 38 45 53 58 60);
  L61-120 H 64 68 72 77 84 87 93 97 102 109 112 119, N 63 75 78 83 88 90 103 105 108 113 118 120. 1.5.0 stage: L1-60 S 25,
  H 11, N 6, C 8, E 7, NH 47, NC 53, NE 58.

2. GENERATION (js/levelgen.js)
- generateLevel(L, seed, base) / levelGenerator(L, seed, base) / levelSteps(L, seed, base); base defaults to levelTypeOf(L).base.
  - horde: holdgen.holdSpec(L, seed, { debut: L === LEVEL_TYPES.horde.debut }) -> yield* generateRunSteps(L, seed, spec.run)
    -> holdgen.generateHoldScript(run, spec) (the run's boss replaced by { type: 'hold', at, spec }).
  - any other base: the campaign attempt loop (unchanged).
- Every generated campaign script carries base ('standard' | 'horde'), eTarget (E_boss or E_hold), finale ('boss' | 'hold': the
  event that ends the run) and starMetric ('survivors'). Night scripts are the day scripts. The authored L1 has none of them
  (level.js reads eTarget as eBoss, finale as 'boss').
- Generation is deterministic per (L, seed, base). With the type fields stripped, the L1-30 x 3 seeds scripts are identical to
  r8-140 dbfbe54 (scriptdigest 436a1cf5...); with them the D42 reference becomes 694a0612... .

3. LEVEL RUNNER (js/level.js)
- Type: start(L, seed) resolves this._type = levelTypeOf(L, ?type= with ?debug=1); endless and the title are a plain run.
  Script cache and prefetch jobs are keyed `L|seed|base`; the authored L1 is used only for a standard base.
- MODE_OF = { horde: 'hold' }. A mode level's script events go to level as before; its finale event (script.finale, 'hold')
  begins the mode: phase = the mode's name ('hold'), mode.begin(script, P_BEGIN) with P_BEGIN = { threat 1, assistK (the
  REINFORCEMENTS steps; the mode gives them, level adds nothing), firstMeet, seed, runDecisions (counted gate decisions so
  far), event (the finale event) }. Every other unknown event goes to mode.fireEvent(ev) (a false return warns once).
- The mode reports through metric() (what the stars count), fraction() (0..1 progress of the mode part), stat(out) (level fills
  defaults first: holdActions, holdSurgeWindows, eased[3], staggers, lineHeld, kits (left), kills, surgesCleared) and is ended
  by level with end() when the result is committed (its scene stays until the next reset). A run ends through boss:dead,
  squad:dead (the usual theatres) or finish(won, cause) from the mode while the run is live (the same theatre first; cause
  'boss' / 'squad' / the mode's, e.g. 'overrun').
- Road: stopRoad(seconds, atDistance) — linear stop over seconds, or exactly at atDistance when it lies ahead; resumeRoad(seconds).
- debugSkip(kind): 'run' (default) moves the road 20 m before the finale event (QA LVL-11 consumes what it jumps over); other
  kinds go to the running mode's debugSkip. smoke --skip uses it.
- Coins per type: the level bonus x bonusMult (also the game-over consolation); the survivor bonus counts above
  survivorFrom x eTarget; crowd:kills batches add run.kills and run.killCoins and are credited as 'kill' coins directly (fx
  answers crowd:kills itself); a hold clear pays LINE HELD (HORDE_GEN.coins.lineHeldPerL x L, 'bonus') and refunds each kit
  left (kitRefund, 'refund'). The results breakdown gains bonusMode (LINE HELD), so the chips still add up.
- Score (D45): the RUN formula + SCORE.hold.lineHeld on a clear with no section ever broken + SCORE.hold.stagger per stagger.
- Stars: the mode's metric (else survivors) against script.eTarget via starNeed with starThreeOf(L, key).
- Game-over fraction: a plain run distance / length; a mode level runShare x the run's, once the mode began runShare +
  (1 - runShare) x mode.fraction().
- Replay (D21): save.isReplay(L, typeKey) (cleared in that type, or listed in retypeRewardSkip) — a re-typed level's first
  new-type clear pays full; retypeReward = cleared before but not a replay.
- First meeting (D34): save.meetType(key) at every run start records modes[key].metAtFrontier = highestUnlocked the first time;
  firstMeet = modes[key].clears === 0 && metAtFrontier >= debut + meetAfter. level.firstMeet / level.type are public.
- REINFORCEMENTS (D30 / D35 / A1 / A7): _runCounted() — counted gate decisions >= max(minDecisions, minShare x events reached),
  or, once a mode began, mode.stat holdActions >= LEVELS.curve.assist.holdActions over >= holdSurges surge windows. A counted
  fail adds to _assistStreak; a run left alone neither adds nor resets. Steps k = min(cap, fails - assistAfterFails + 1) with
  cap assistMaxSteps ('soldiers') or HORDE_GEN.assist.maxSteps ('kits'). 'soldiers': + ceil(assistStartFrac x E_boss x k) at
  the start (unchanged); 'kits': nothing at the start, k reaches the mode as assistK (and run.assistK).
- item:grant { id, x, z } of a PICKUPS.eventItems item adds its kits to run.kits (the hold starts with them).
- Payloads: level:start / complete / failed gain typeKey, base, night, finale, eTarget, stat (a copy), cause, firstMeet,
  retypeReward, assistK; complete also metric; failed also counted (the fail joined the streak). district:change gains
  modeKey ('' at the title), modeName (STRINGS.modes[key] once the types text defines it) and modeColor.
- _applyDistrict(seconds, night) also calls render.setNight(night, seconds) once the renderer has it (P5).

4. READINESS GATE (D8, ARCH §6)
- level.ready(L, seed): the script is authored (standard L1) or cached, and _partsReady(type): render.programsReady(
  render.variantForLevel(night)) when the renderer has the night API, and every PREP_OF[base] system's programsReady
  (horde: crowd, hold).
- level.prepareFor(L, seed) -> Promise (never rejects) resolving to ready(L): the script generated in START_SLICE_MS timer tasks
  (the prefetch queue's job) plus render.preparePrograms(v) / crowd.prepare() / hold.prepare() for what is not ready.
- requestStart / requestRestart (PLAY, NEXT, LEVELS tile, RETRY, REPLAY, RESTART) start at once only when ready(L); otherwise
  the menu button keeps its .starting spinner while the script generates and the programs compile, and the run starts once both
  are done (a state change drops it, as before). Boot with ?level=N awaits prepareFor behind the boot screen. A bare start()
  (tools, the harness) still starts and warns once 'level.unprepared' if programs are missing.

5. SAVE v2 (js/save.js; SAVE_VERSION 2, additive)
- Level records { stars, bestSurvivors, bestScore, bestCoins, clears, t (type key), metric[, prev { t, bestSurvivors,
  bestScore, bestCoins, metric }] }. modes { <8 keys>: { runs, clears, kills, bestKills, metAtFrontier } }. settings gain
  nightBright and leftHanded (false).
- v1 -> v2: every record t 'standard', metric = bestSurvivors; modes.standard.clears = all clears, metAtFrontier 1; nothing reset.
- recordLevel(level, { stars, survivors, score, coins, typeKey, metric }): a clear in another type than rec.t moves the bests to
  rec.prev and starts the new type's; stars stay max; modes[typeKey].clears++. isReplay(level, typeKey, skip); meetType(key);
  recordModeRun(key, kills).
- A 1.3.0 build reading a v2 blob keeps it byte-identical (tools/check-save.js runs the 1.3.0 migrate from git 441104b).

6. ITEMS
- PICKUPS.items gains 'item.kit' and 'item.kit2'; PICKUPS.eventItems { 'item.kit': { kind 'event', kits 1 }, 'item.kit2': { kind
  'event', kits 2 } }. pickups.grantItem emits item:grant { id, x, z } for them (no system call, no warning), then item:pickup
  as for any item (fx icon flight; level's NEW card / hint).
- HINTS 'item.kit' / 'item.kit2', CODEX pickups entries with NEW cards (unlock L4 / L13: the Horde debut and the first Horde
  level from HORDE_GEN.run.kitsLaneFrom on the 1.4.0 map).

7. TOOLS
- tools/check-save.js (new): the save v2 checks (migration, replay rule, re-typed first clears, metAtFrontier, rec.prev, the 1.3.0
  migrate round trip, sanitation).
- tools/validate-levels.js: default L1-60; --typesOn [list|all], --type <key>, --rotation (map L1-120, R1-R8 to L300 at the
  checked flags, the 1.4.0 and the 1.5.0 stage, eBossOf = curve.eBoss to L300); every script must carry base / eTarget of its
  type; a Horde script is checked as its run phase (holdsim.runPartOf against runCurve) plus validateHoldSection (runs 3, D37).
  R1 finale on a standard base; R2 slot 1 S; R3 type debuts = LEVEL_TYPES debut, never slot 1 / 5; R4 no repeated special base,
  no consecutive night; R5 (1.5.0 stage) every 10 levels from L31 hold every special base and night; R6 triples L8, x3 / ÷3 L11
  on a standard base, zombie debuts L1-3 / 5 / 6 and the Twins L16 as S; R7 no pickup debut on a Horde level or on
  TEACHING.noPickup (L4, L7, L18; A14 put the railgun on L12, CHASE's 1.5.0 slot); R8 every boss debuts on a standard or
  Horde level.
- tools/check-codex.js (f): every kind-'event' item is grantable, quotes its kits in entry / card / hint, has a NEW card, and its
  unlock is its first Horde level.
